# Introduction {.unnumbered}

**Unit 5: AI in the Real World**

What AI means for your privacy, your future job, and the news you see.

We will look at real scams, real changes happening at work right now, and have honest conversations about what is coming.

***

## What You'll Learn

By the end of this unit, you will be able to:

* Protect your privacy when you use apps and AI
* Recognize AI scams and help your family stay safe
* Describe how AI is changing jobs right now
* Think about how AI changes the news you see
